// An interval asserted to contain the true value with the stated confidence
// Level (e.g. 0.95). Lower does not exceed Upper.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Confidence_interval)
type ConfidenceInterval
    implements IValue
{
    Lower: Number;
    Upper: Number;
    Level: Probability;
}
